technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with ADX trend confirmation present, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, negative momentum, weak volume) and lack of bullish reversal signals make this a low-probability entry despite potential bounce setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (373.76) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 63 days presents moderate event risk for industrials sector.
